# MyIntel

> MyIntel (MyIntel Co.) helps older adults in the Denver metro area, Colorado, stay safely in their own homes. We check the home for fall risks, set up simple sensors and a help button for free, notice when the daily routine changes, and a trained person at a UL-listed response center answers the help button 24/7.

Key facts:
- Service area: the Denver metro area, Colorado. The free online home check (HomeCheck) works anywhere.
- Founded by Austin Gough. Contact: (720) 989-1123, info@myintelhome.com. We reply within one business day.
- Home safety visits are done by licensed, insured occupational therapists with CAPS (Certified Aging-in-Place Specialist) certification.
- No cameras. Room sensors notice movement, not faces.
- Setup by insured, professional installers is free with every plan.
- Plans: HomeAware (help button answered 24/7, morning routine check in one key room), HomeProtect (adds routine change alerts, door sensors, fall sensing in one room, voice help and a home safety visit), HomeComplete (adds fall sensing in a second room and a bed sensor).
- Pricing: quoted per home. Call for a quote.
- MyIntel does not bill insurance or Medicare, and does not replace medical care or 911.
- For home care companies: MyIntel supplies the sensors, help buttons, staff training and a team dashboard. The care company's staff set up and look after their own clients.
